Privacy notice

[DRAFT for legal review. Have this notice reviewed against the Kenya Data Protection Act, 2019 and Chestnut’s actual data practices before launch.]

What we collect

When you complete a form on this website we collect the details you enter, such as your name, contact details and information about the cover you are asking about.

How we use it

We use your details to respond to your enquiry, prepare quotations and provide advice. With your instruction, we share the information insurers need with them to obtain terms.

Your choices

You may ask what we hold about you and ask us to correct or delete it, subject to legal and regulatory requirements. Contact us using the details on our contact page.
